evidence.title: Contrastive Representation-Guided Genetic Minority Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification

summary: Researchers introduce Contrastive Representation-Guided Genetic Minority Oversampling to improve classification accuracy in imbalanced time-series data. The method leverages genetic algorithms and contrastive learning to enhance minority class representation.
title: New AI Technique Addresses Imbalanced Time-Series Classification with Genetic Oversampling
